title: The Pullman house's great chimney stack on 18th Street
items: A tall stone stack now stands on the 18th Street cornice, just east of the south-west corner. It runs up past the mansard to a capped top, as an 1890s photograph by J. W. Taylor shows it.
The roof's other tall stack has moved to the spot two more pictures agree on, and it now rises about a metre and a half higher.
The 1890 Albertype plate of the house is now one of the pictures it is checked against.
